composites.name: yalla-real-springs
composites.description: Pair-wise spring relaxation driven by the REAL ya||a GPU solver (requires CUDA + an NVIDIA GPU). Generates a .cu model, compiles it with nvcc against a ya||a checkout, and round-trips agent state through the compiled binary each step. On a CPU/macOS host this raises YallaCudaUnavailable — use yalla-springs-demo (reproduction) instead.

n_cells.description: Number of agents in the random sphere (fixed population).

force_kernel.description: Native ya||a force kernel: spring, differential_adhesion, or relu.

dt.description: ya||a integrator step size (matches the springs.cu example).

interval.description: Process interval; the binary runs round(interval/dt) take_step calls.

seed.description: RNG seed for the initial sphere (built in NumPy, then handed to ya||a).

cuda_arch.description: nvcc target architecture; set to match your GPU (e.g. sm_70, sm_80).

composites.name: yalla-springs-with-viz
composites.description: yalla pair-wise ABM demo (NumPy reproduction — runs without a GPU) with a wired Visualization Step. Each update produces a Plotly HTML figure of the running scalar trajectories, written to the 'viz_html' store.

n_cells.description: Initial number of agents in the random sphere.

viz_title.description: Title displayed at the top of the Plotly figure.

composites.name: yalla-springs-demo
composites.description: Tiny yalla pair-wise ABM demo (NumPy reproduction — runs without a GPU): a small random sphere of agents relaxes under a short-range spring kernel. Emits gyration_radius, mean_neighbor_distance, sorting_score, and n_cells each step. For the real ya||a GPU solver see yalla-real-springs.

n_cells.description: Initial number of agents in the random sphere.

force_kernel.description: Pair-wise force kernel (spring, differential_adhesion, relu, lennard_jones_soft, ...).

interval.description: Process interval; advanced via Euler sub-steps of size dt.
